// CASE js_inorder_canonical expect=pass
export async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
// CASE js_inorder_wrapped expect=pass
export async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    log(await step(item));
  }
}
// CASE js_inorder_spread expect=pass
export async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    log(...await step(item));
  }
}
// CASE js_inorder_spread_space expect=pass
export async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    log(... await step(item));
  }
}
// CASE js_steps_spread expect=pass
export async function inOrderSteps(steps, { reason }) {
  void reason;
  for (const step of steps) {
    log(...await step());
  }
}
